gate: Hidden-Completion Response State / Minimal Markov Closure Gate

single_chiral_scalar_test.result: The v13.10 chiral scalar is a useful discriminator for one hidden direction but is not a sufficient response state.

fixed_N3_hidden_rank.theorem: At this generic faithful N=3 point, all 27 independent weight-3 Pauli hidden directions affect the complete nine-local-source QMAR response to first order. Thus no proper linear projection of the weight-3 moment sector can be generically sufficient for all these response jets near this point.

fixed_N3_exact_closure.moments_through_weight3: complete Pauli tomography / full density state
fixed_N3_exact_closure.meaning: For fixed N=3, augmenting one/two-body data by all 27 weight-3 moments reconstructs rho and makes QMAR autonomous because nothing is hidden.

ETL_hierarchy_no_go.construction: rho_±=2^-N(I ± epsilon Z_1...Z_N), N=k+1; retained all moments through weight k; source P=Z_N; observable O=Z_1...Z_k
ETL_hierarchy_no_go.theorem: For every fixed finite k, there exist N=k+1 positive commuting states identical on all Pauli moments through weight k but with different ETL/PGRL derivatives of a retained k-body observable under a one-body source. Therefore no fixed finite body-order moment truncation is autonomous uniformly in system size.
ETL_hierarchy_no_go.scope: Exact ETL/PGRL no-go; does not rely on exchange dynamics or noncommutativity.

factorization_control.result: The product/factorized manifold is not invariant under generic ETL two-body source deformation, so factorization is a constitutive approximation rather than an exact closure.

relation_to_prior_RCCL.prior: v12.46 found the analogous no-fixed-order hierarchy under overlapping exchange and introduced RCCL.
relation_to_prior_RCCL.new: v13.13 proves the same architectural obstruction directly for ETL/PGRL source deformation in a commuting control, while quantifying the full hidden rank for the current N=3 QMAR problem.
relation_to_prior_RCCL.RCCL: still the correct missing object: enlarge the retained state to the full needed higher-incidence data or derive a canonical lifting/closure.
